accueil.amorceH1: T-shirts, hoodies, and caps made in Quebec
accueil.amorceH4: /** with a little help from DALL-E 😉 **/
accueil.para1: Today, the t-shirt is an essential item in everyone's wardrobe. At a time when environmental concerns are more pressing than ever, we prefer t-shirts made in Quebec to reduce environmental impact and highlight local craftsmanship.
accueil.para2: V-neck, crew neck, loose or fitted, short-sleeved or long-sleeved for those who feel the cold, plain or patterned to style an outfit… The t-shirt is available in a variety of colors, styles, and patterns.
